provenance: Numeric facts manually curated from the original diagnostic results; no raw configuration or identity data is included.

retained_changes.local_redirect_processing: Allow necessary locally redirected proxy and DNS processing in the isolated business network; completed before BBR download baselines.

historical_fixed_32mib_downloads.throughput_definition: Received bytes divided by wall time. Before results were partial failed tasks; no complete-task speedup factor is claimed.

historical_overnight_US_validation.small_request_admission_window: Predefined load steady window by request start; admitted failures remain in denominator. Out-of-window samples are not represented by these counts.
historical_overnight_US_validation.tail_evidence: Some client tail events coincided with outer proxy TCP retransmission increments; this is sampled correlation, not packet-level causality. At least one timeout remains unexplained.
historical_overnight_US_validation.bare_iperf3_branch_skip_reason: Required tool and precise temporary test ingress were not available; no installation or temporary port exposure was performed.

pending_at_case_end: Real phones, real streaming platform, chosen bitrate and concurrent-device acceptance
Regression during the original problem period and peak conditions
Maximum path capacity and any provider-side shaping
Exact network damage location and all timeout mechanisms
Independent confirmation that the test client was restored to its original access network
data_boundaries: Historical success is limited to these samples and targets.
Partial timed-out downloads must not be used as completed-task throughput.
Test pacing caps are not production caps or link-capacity claims.
STUN request timeouts are not video packet loss.
System counters cannot be assigned to one proxy connection without additional evidence.
New toolkit offline validation is separate from historical real-network validation.

historical_controlled_US_proxy_tcp_compa.interpretation: Supports improved sender behavior for these samples; does not show removal of propagation delay, a stable multiplicative gain, or exact damage location.
historical_controlled_US_proxy_tcp_compa.path_kind: Fixed Xray RAW transport through a SOCKS entrance; actual sending congestion control checked

subsequent_progress.note: This object remains the historical phase snapshot. Later measurements and this speed task cleanup are recorded separately; no original pending item is silently rewritten.
